falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,150 on any single day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern is broken; that pattern held above 4,150 during its formation, and a breach would indicate this is not a valid bottom structure but rather a continuation of the prior downtrend, invalidating the 'bottom' signal

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 25 for 3 consecutive trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 40 assumes moderate fear, not panic; sustained VIX above 25 indicates genuine systemic stress rather than a capitulation washout, meaning the 'bottom' was not a bottom but a mid-crash pause

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% and holds there for 5+ consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This would signal flight-to-safety bond buying inconsistent with an equity bottom; in the original bottom_2024_aug pattern, yields stabilized or rose as equities recovered, so sustained sub-3.80% yields indicate macro deterioration that invalidates the bullish bottom thesis

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
